scalars.scalar_value: Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, two years of professional experience.

items.item_text: Certified Red Cross first aid and CPR training or the ability to achieve certification within the first three months of employment.
Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, two years of professional experience.
Solid abilities to consult and advise on instructional/research design/construction experiments and furniture pieces.

Incumbent must possess a high level of motivation and initiative.  Must be willing to support and actively contribute to a highly collaborative team environment, with a proper customer-service attitude and active, appropriate communication to the customer and supervisor.
Candidates must possess woodshop fabrication skills and digital fabrication skills.
basic metalworking/welding, sculpture skills, concrete, and moldmaking.
Advanced knowledge of jig construction, fixturing, and problem-solving unconventional building methods.
Working knowledge of digital fabrication tools/software for laser cutting, 3D printing, and CNC cutting.
Ability to instruct, mentor, and assist a diverse student population. Be an enthusiastic educational collaborator.
Strong interpersonal skills including sensitivity, tact, and diplomacy to develop and maintain effective working relationships with students, faculty, and staff.
Ability to focus, be patient, and communicate effectively in a high-stress, busy, and loud working environment.
Demonstrates ability to read, write, and follow oral/written instructions provided in English. Ability to absorb and execute complex instructions.
Punctuality, reliability, and professionalism are required.

Must be able to access work sites including heights and confined spaces; walk, stand, bend, kneel, and work on your feet for extended periods. Ability to move and handle heavy objects. Able to lift 25 pounds.
